<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>SnapFrame — Capture, Create & Share What You Love</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --color-black: #000000;
      --color-white: #ffffff;
      --color-purple: #7638FA;
      --color-orange: #FF7A00;
      --color-gray-50: #f8f9fb;
      --color-gray-100: #f0f1f5;
      --color-gray-200: #e4e5eb;
      --color-gray-300: #d1d3db;
      --color-gray-400: #9a9db0;
      --color-gray-500: #6b6e82;
      --color-gray-600: #4a4d5f;
      --color-gray-700: #2e3042;
      --color-gray-800: #1a1c2b;
      --color-gray-900: #0f111a;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      --shadow-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
      --transition: 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    *, *::before, *::after {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      color: var(--color-gray-800);
      background: var(--color-white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    a {
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
    }

    button {
      border: none;
      background: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    ul, ol {
      list-style: none;
    }

    /* Header */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .header-inner {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 64px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 22px;
      color: var(--color-black);
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-purple), var(--color-orange));
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .nav-desktop {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .nav-desktop a {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--color-gray-600);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-desktop a:hover {
      color: var(--color-black);
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 10px 22px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--color-black);
      color: var(--color-white);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--color-gray-800);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--color-black);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--color-gray-300);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      border-color: var(--color-black);
      background: var(--color-gray-50);
    }

    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 5px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .hamburger:hover {
      background: var(--color-gray-100);
    }

    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 20px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--color-black);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) {
      transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg);
    }

    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) {
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) {
      transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg);
    }

    /* Mobile Nav Overlay */
    .mobile-nav {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 64px 0 0 0;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.98);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      z-index: 999;
      padding: 32px 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-nav.open {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .mobile-nav a {
      padding: 14px 16px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--color-gray-800);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-nav a:hover {
      background: var(--color-gray-100);
    }

    .mobile-nav .btn {
      margin-top: 8px;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      padding: 140px 24px 100px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #faf5ff 0%, #fff7ed 50%, #ffffff 100%);
    }

    .hero-bg-shapes {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-shape {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(80px);
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    .hero-shape-1 {
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      background: var(--color-purple);
      top: -120px;
      right: -80px;
      opacity: 0.12;
    }

    .hero-shape-2 {
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: var(--color-orange);
      bottom: -80px;
      left: -60px;
      opacity: 0.1;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero-content {
      max-width: 720px;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      background: rgba(118,56,250,0.08);
      color: var(--color-purple);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5.5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      color: var(--color-black);
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .hero-title span {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-purple), var(--color-orange));
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .hero-desc {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--color-gray-500);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 32px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-purple), #9b5cff);
      color: white;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(118,56,250,0.3);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .hero-cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(118,56,250,0.4);
    }

    .hero-visual {
      position: absolute;
      right: 0;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 420px;
      height: 420px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .hero-visual-ring {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px dashed var(--color-gray-200);
      animation: spin 40s linear infinite;
    }

    .hero-visual-ring-1 { width: 420px; height: 420px; }
    .hero-visual-ring-2 { width: 320px; height: 320px; animation-direction: reverse; animation-duration: 30s; }
    .hero-visual-ring-3 { width: 220px; height: 220px; animation-duration: 20s; }

    @keyframes spin {
      from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    .hero-visual-center {
      width: 140px;
      height: 140px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-purple), var(--color-orange));
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(118,56,250,0.3);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .hero-visual-center svg {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      color: white;
    }

    .hero-orb {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-purple), var(--color-orange));
      opacity: 0.9;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .hero-orb-1 { width: 48px; height: 48px; top: 40px; left: 40px; animation-delay: 0s; }
    .hero-orb-2 { width: 32px; height: 32px; top: 80px; right: 60px; animation-delay: 1s; }
    .hero-orb-3 { width: 56px; height: 56px; bottom: 60px; right: 40px; animation-delay: 2s; }
    .hero-orb-4 { width: 28px; height: 28px; bottom: 100px; left: 80px; animation-delay: 3s; }

    @keyframes float {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-12px); }
    }

    /* Sections */
    .section {
      padding: 100px 24px;
    }

    .section-inner {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .section-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      color: var(--color-purple);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.2;
      color: var(--color-black);
      letter-spacing: -0.8px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-desc {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--color-gray-500);
      max-width: 560px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .section-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--color-purple);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .section-link:hover {
      gap: 10px;
      color: #5a20d8;
    }

    /* Features */
    .features {
      background: var(--color-white);
    }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .features-visual {
      position: relative;
      height: 420px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3eeff, #fff0e0);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .features-visual-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 32px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .feature-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .feature-card-icon {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      font-size: 20px;
    }

    .feature-card-icon.purple { background: rgba(118,56,250,0.1); }
    .feature-card-icon.orange { background: rgba(255,122,0,0.1); }
    .feature-card-icon.pink { background: rgba(236,72,153,0.1); }
    .feature-card-icon.blue { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.1); }

    .feature-card h4 {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--color-black);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .feature-card p {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--color-gray-400);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* Safety */
    .safety {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f8f9fb 0%, #ffffff 100%);
    }

    .safety-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .safety-visual {
      position: relative;
      height: 420px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e9, #e3f2fd);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      order: -1;
    }

    .safety-shield {
      width: 160px;

  <script>
    // Hamburger menu toggle
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
      mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = mobileNav.classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
    });

    // Close mobile nav on link click
    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        hamburger.classList.remove('active');
        mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      });
    });

    // News carousel: smooth scroll with mouse drag
    const carousel = document.getElementById('newsCarousel');
    let isDown = false;
    let startX;
    let scrollLeft;

    carousel.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDown = true;
      carousel.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
      startX = e.pageX - carousel.offsetLeft;
      scrollLeft = carousel.scrollLeft;
    });

    carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      isDown = false;
      carousel.style.cursor = 'grab';
    });

    carousel.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      isDown = false;
      carousel.style.cursor = 'grab';
    });

    carousel.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDown) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const x = e.pageX - carousel.offsetLeft;
      const walk = (x - startX) * 1.5;
      carousel.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - walk;
    });

    carousel.style.cursor = 'grab';

    // Header shadow on scroll
    const header = document.querySelector('.header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      if (window.scrollY > 10) {
        header.style.boxShadow = '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)';
      } else {
        header.style.boxShadow = 'none';
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

steps.message:
The SnapFrame corporate landing page has been built and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

### Structure (per `task_input.json`)
1. **Header** — Fixed navbar with logo, desktop nav links (Features, Safety, Creators, News), "Log in" button, and hamburger toggle for mobile
2. **Hero** — Gradient background, bold headline with gradient accent text, value prop description, and "Try it now" CTA with animated orb visual
3. **Features** — Two-column layout with feature cards (Clips, Stories, DMs, Search & Explore) and section link
4. **Safety** — Trust-focused section with soft green/blue tones, animated shield icon, floating safety badges
5. **Creators** — Aspirational section with warm gradient, rotating spotlight, floating creator avatars
6. **Tagline Banner** — Full-width vibrant gradient banner with pattern overlay
7. **News Carousel** — Horizontally scrollable card carousel with:
   - Snap scrolling
   - Mouse drag support
   - Category tag pills
   - Thumbnails, titles, and dates for all 4 articles
8. **CTA Download** — App Store & Google Play buttons
9. **Footer** — 6-column grid (About, Features, Safety, Community, External Links, Partner Links), language selector, social icons, legal links

### Key Interactions
- **Hamburger menu** — Toggles mobile overlay nav; closes on link click
- **News carousel** — Touch/swipe on mobile, mouse-drag on desktop, with `scroll-snap-type` for smooth snapping
- **Scroll-aware header** — Subtle shadow appears on scroll

### Design
- Brand colors: `#000000`, `#7638FA`, `#FF7A00`
- Typography: Inter + Plus Jakarta Sans
- Fully responsive with breakpoints at 1024px, 768px, and 480px
- No build step required — open directly in a browser
